newsitem.title: USA: SMT Health Services sets 7 pct stock div.
newsitem.headline: SMT Health Services sets 7 pct stock div.

text.p: SMT Health Services Inc said on Wednesday its board of directors authorized a seven percent common stock dividend payable on or about January 20 to shareholders of record on January 10.
Fractional shares would be paid in cash, the company said.

The company's publicly traded warrants would also be recapitalized to reflect the common stock dividend, SMT said. Each warrant would now entitle the holder to buy 1.1235 shares of stock for $7 per share, and the effective cost of the warrant has been reduced to $6.23 per share from $6.67 per share, the company said.
SMT said it issued a five percent stock dividend in July.
